description: Synthetic semantic-recall cases designed to expose failures that exact, lexical, and hand-authored association routes may miss. Oracle relevance is evaluator-only.

events.text: The codename for Project Oriole is Blue Cedar.
My deployment requirement is that all inference remain fully offline on ARM64 hardware.
The Project Atlas schedule changed from September to February 14.
I keep the backup encryption key in the red fireproof envelope.
My preferred grinder setting for the Ethiopian beans is 17 clicks.
The motorcycle shop estimated the repairs at $8,420.
I no longer use Docker for local Prometheist development; PostgreSQL runs directly on Windows.
The release candidate must preserve the append-only event history without rewriting authoritative events.
My emergency contact for the conference is Dana Ruiz.
The spare laptop is stored in the hall closet.
I prefer the quarterly review deck to use a dark theme with minimal decoration.
The fallback database backup is copied to an encrypted external SSD every Sunday night.
